findings.title: Default INI option matching performs unbounded quadratic work
findings.evidence: The default ConfigParser option matcher accepts overlapping lazy-name and whitespace searches. Six retained probes cover valid and invalid option lines at 4,000, 8,000 and 16,000 whitespace characters; parser time grows approximately fourfold per input doubling.
findings.impact: The parser work is not bounded by the declared per-character reservation, including options in an unselected metadata section.
findings.required_change: Use a fixed linear option grammar or equivalent deterministic bounded preflight for both valid and invalid whitespace cases; preserve strict duplicate, continuation, selected-section and default rejection semantics. Add deterministic matcher/work-count regressions, not timing thresholds.
findings.timing_qualification: All six observations completed within independent two-second operational limits; timings are diagnostic evidence only.

findings.title: Opaque ProjectExtensions content is reported as a declaration
findings.evidence: The retained synthetic project returns both OpaqueData inside ProjectExtensions and the genuine Declared PackageReference as declaration records, without diagnostics.
findings.impact: The extractor converts non-MSBuild data into a declared dependency because it checks only the immediate ItemGroup parent.
findings.required_change: Exclude opaque non-MSBuild subtrees or fail closed on unsupported context before declaration extraction. Preserve genuine Project/Target/Choose declarations and condition-presence semantics without build evaluation. Add an opaque-data negative case and genuine-declaration control.

findings.title: Complete the scoped typed contracts and intent comments
findings.evidence: Python helper contracts at source lines 70 and 116 do not explicitly type all parameters. The test parse helper at line 21 and parameterized test contracts omit the required typed inputs, returns, raises and side effects. Nontrivial comprehensions around test lines 119-122, 178-186 and 250 lack immediate intent comments.
findings.required_change: Complete the affected helper/test contracts and immediately preceding intent comments under self-explanatory-code-commenting. Preserve all existing assertions and parametrizations; keep each file at most 500 lines.
